description: §23.2.4a E-FOREIGN-006 — a tool slice declares a top-level `const` with the same name as its `in:{}` crossing (the crossing is the sealed slice's parameter).
rationale: §23.2.4a: "a crossing name that the slice ALSO declares at its TOP LEVEL … This SHALL be a compile error (E-FOREIGN-006) that NAMES the shadowed binding."
